name: Python 3
updateContentCommand: [ -f packages.txt ] && sudo apt update && sudo apt upgrade -y && sudo xargs apt install -y <packages.txt; pip3 install --user uv && uv sync --locked && echo 'Packages installed and requirements met'

postAttachCommand.server: uv run streamlit run app/main.py --server.enableCORS false --server.enableXsrfProtection false
